profile.headline: Research Engineer. Building scalable, high-performance systems with mathematical precision.
profile.summary: AI systems engineer building LLM inference and training infrastructure at Fastino. I own the full stack from multi-GPU optimization (profiling NCCL, tuning DeepSpeed/FSDP on A100 clusters) to production serving and fine-tuning pipelines across cloud GPU providers. Background in mathematical and computational engineering (Stanford MS) and quantitative finance.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff
positions.locationName: Palo Alto, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Own the production LLM inference platform — multi-provider routing, LoRA adapter orchestration, and model serving across serverless GPU and managed ML endpoints.
• Own the end-to-end fine-tuning pipeline for NER encoders, MoE LoRA decoders, and diffusion language models on multi-GPU infrastructure.
• Profile and optimize distributed training on A100 clusters using Nsight Systems and custom NCCL analysis tooling; diagnosed and resolved a communication bottleneck that recovered ~10-20x training throughput.
• Tune distributed training strategies (DeepSpeed ZeRO, FSDP, DDP) with gradient checkpointing, OOM mitigation, and mixed-precision for large-model workloads.
• Design and ship backward-compatible API migrations across inference, training, and validation layers with zero client downtime.
• Build async job infrastructure and harden cloud deployment reliability (SQS, ECS/ALB).
Stack: Python, PyTorch, CUDA, NCCL, DeepSpeed, FSDP, Modal, SageMaker, Fireworks, Nsight Systems, GCP, FastAPI, SQS, ECS, PostgreSQL

positions.title: Backend/Infrastructure Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Full-stack development for high efficiency multi-tenant web applications, utilising React, Python, and PostgreSQL.
• Designed and deployed microservices architecture on AWS EC2 and GKE, implementing automated CI/CD pipelines, horizontal and vertical pod autoscaling, and infrastructure-as-code using Kuberneters/Helm.
• Manages projects with radical ownership, from conception to production, with a focus on resiliancy and scalability.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Kubernetes · React.js · Django · PostgreSQL · DevOps

positions.title: Course Assistant
positions.description:
CME212 - Advanced Software Development
• Redesigned ICMEs’ graduate course in Advanced Software Development with Professor Andreas Santucci to improve learning outcomes.
• Designed an Auto-Grader for complex graphical simulation, including a testing-suite for diagnostic purposes.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Research Assistant- Stanford Vision and Learning Lab
• Developed and analysed optimal annotation strategies for economical applications of Computer Vision methods in a Healthcare setting.
• Analysed optimal annotation strategies for budget-conscious computer vision algorithms.
• Compared current clinical methodologies to computer vision-based alternatives, considering both clinical utility and implementation cost.
• Presented analysis to a group of doctors, researchers, and clinical practitioners to spread the understanding of the capabilities of ML systems in Healthcare.
positions.insights: Skills: Quantitative Analytics · Research · Machine Learning · Statistics · Programming

positions.title: Student Research Assistant
positions.description:
As part of the Stanford ICME Xplore program, I worked with Sandia National Labs developing device-agnostic machine learning-based error rate prediction methodologies for quantum computers.

Including: 
• Used RSA to analyse cross-device CNN model similarity to optimise cross-device prediction.
• Implemented multi-headed CNN models for cross-device prediction.
• Experimented with embedding methods for quantum circuits to improve a CNN’s device seperability.
positions.insights: Skills: PyTorch · Quantum Error Rate Prediction · Graph Neural Nets · Deep Learning · Programming

positions.title: Fintech Data Scientist
positions.description:
• Developed visualization methodologies for Credit Analysts to access large quantities of offsite data in an efficient and useable manner.
• Worked with a team of Data Scientists and Credit Analysts to ensure that the product being developed was both solving a problem and developing a usable tool.
• Developed, Back Tested and Calibrated systematic rules to isolate emerging areas of interest in NLP data, reducing research times and streamlining the discovery process for Credit Analysts.
• Implemented my work in a package to allow for simplified code maintenance and the capability to add additional functionality as the use cases develop.
positions.insights: Skills: Quantitative Analytics · Research · Data Science · Machine Learning · Statistics · Programming · Data Structures

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: CME 102 - Ordinary Differential Equations for Engineers
positions.insights: Skills: ODE · Mathematics · Mathematical Modeling · Programming

positions.title: Portfolio Manager
positions.description: Ran £30,000 in an actively managed portfolio, with an investing universe of long-only direct investments. The goal of the portfolio is to expose students to the financial world and gain experience interacting with and investing in financial instruments.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Mathematical and Computational Engineering - Finance Specialisation

volunteerExperiences.description: I helped to build a school in the slums of Nakuru, Kenya. I was part of a project that was building schools across sub-saharan Africa. The goal of this project was to increase the accesibility of education in Africa and thus give the young students a better start to life.
